title: Aircraft cutout — rear perspective
slide_intent: Inspect markings without scenic context because the object itself must carry recognition.
strategic_value: A crane tail and fuselage wordmark can remain legible as a connected identity from a rear perspective.
demonstration: A transparent-background aircraft rendering shows the rear, upper fuselage and dark crane tail.
practical_value: Assess logo and wordmark placement on the vehicle before adding a campaign background.
